{{Quote|Sessaly, stay in the basement, do you hear me? Sessaly? Sessaly!|Ovolot Qail Uthan to Sessaly|<ref name="IC 501st" />}}
'''Sessaly''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]]. Sessaly was also a distant cousin of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Gibad was one of the worlds that defied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When the Gibadan government refused to cooperate after the given deadline, Palpatine unleashed a [[FG36|virus]] on the world created by Uthan. It was not known if Sessaly survived the biological attack, despite being commed by Uthan to take refuge shortly before the attack.<ref name="IC 501st" />
